facts.text: Eligible undergraduate students from participating western states and territories pay 150% of the in-state tuition rate at UAA through the Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE).

sources.title: WUE & WRGP | Admissions | University of Alaska Anchorage
sources.quote: Undergraduate students who qualify for the Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE) program pay 150% of the in-state tuition rate.

sources.title: WUE & WRGP | Admissions | University of Alaska Anchorage
sources.quote: To qualify, students must be: Admitted to UAA A resident of a participating state or U.S. territory.
